# VS Code Extension Development

Keep the extension aligned with the UIAutomationMcp repository.

- Provider id: `uia-mcp`
- Bundled binaries: `UIAutomationMcp.McpServer.exe`, `uiamcp.exe`
- Primary checks: `npm run compile`, then `npm run package` when packaging changes
- Keep extension docs and metadata UIAutomationMcp-only
